result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows noticeable alignment inconsistencies: the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) is vertically offset from its neighbors, causing its image, title, and delivery-fee text to sit lower than the adjacent cards. A couple of minor cosmetic points were also noted.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card is vertically misaligned: its image starts lower and is taller than the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria cards, so its title ('Smash Bros Burgers') and delivery fee text sit on a different baseline than the neighboring cards, making the row look broken/staggered.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a fixed, identical image height and top alignment so titles and delivery-fee labels align on the same baseline across the row.

issues.description: The delivery-time badges in the 'Fastest near you' cards are positioned inconsistently (bottom-left overlay at differing vertical offsets across cards), reinforcing the uneven look of the row.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time badge to the same corner with identical padding/offset on every card.

issues.description: The Green Bowl Poké thumbnail appears washed out / low-contrast (nearly blank gray background) compared to the richer imagery on adjacent cards, making it look like a broken or placeholder image.
issues.suggestion: Use a properly rendered photo with similar brightness/contrast treatment as the other restaurant thumbnails, or add a fallback image check.
